name: Ore no Kanojo wa Loli de Kyonyuu de Akiba Kei
original_name: 俺の彼女はロリで巨乳で秋葉系
source:
Main character is an ordinary college student. But life changes for him upon discovering a maid cafe where his childhood friend works together with other cute waitresses.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名普通的大学生。但在发现青梅竹马与其他可爱的女服务生一起工作的女仆咖啡店后，他的人生发生了变化。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
